# Developer Habits Template

## Baseline Principles
- Adhere to KISS. Avoid unnecessary abstractions.
- Base changes on verified code facts.

## Custom Distilled Habits Slot
<!-- Distilled habits generated by habit-distiller -->
- **Defect Sweep**: Fix verified collateral bugs thoroughly without regression.
- **Observable Progress**: Output brief progress notifications during multi-step tasks.
- **Bilingual Docs**: Maintain bilingual READMEs (Chinese default + English) for open-source repositories.
- **Structured Delivery**: Conclude tasks with Before/After markdown tables.
